::: {.lede}
Where to find support and learn from others running experiments: related initiatives
across the European Commission, established research groups that can provide
outside technical support alongside EuroCOMP Lab, and practical resources for
setting up your own evaluation.
:::

## Related European Commission initiatives

Experimentation is gaining ground across the European Commission, not only in Cohesion Policy.

:::: {.cards}
::: {.card-e}
### [Policy experimentation in research and innovation](https://research-and-innovation.ec.europa.eu/strategy/support-policy-making/shaping-eu-research-and-innovation-policy/policy-experimentation-research-and-innovation_en) {.unlisted}
The Directorate-General for Research and Innovation's work on testing research and
innovation policies before scaling them up, including an interactive map of
policy-experimentation organisations across EU Member States and an emerging
Community of Practice.
:::
::::

## International research partners

Established labs and research groups already running rigorous impact evaluations.
Many of them also publish free guidance and training you can use directly.

:::: {.cards}
::: {.card-e}
### [J-PAL](https://www.povertyactionlab.org/) {.unlisted}
The Abdul Latif Jameel Poverty Action Lab specialises in impact evaluation design.

**Go further**

- [Research resources](https://www.povertyactionlab.org/research-resources?view=toc):
  detailed, step-by-step resources for setting up a research programme, from
  design to data collection and analysis.
- [MicroMasters in Data, Economics and Design of Policy](https://micromasters.mit.edu/dedp/):
  an online programme from MIT and J-PAL for those who want to learn more.
:::
::: {.card-e}
### [IPA](https://poverty-action.org/) {.unlisted}
Innovations for Poverty Action designs and rigorously evaluates solutions to poverty.
:::
::: {.card-e}
### [World Bank DIME](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/unit/unit-dec/impactevaluation/about) {.unlisted}
The World Bank's Development Impact Evaluation group.

**Go further**

- [DIME Wiki](https://dimewiki.worldbank.org/): a collaborative, open-source
  resource with guidelines that are easy to understand and apply for users of
  varying levels of expertise.
:::
::: {.card-e}
### [International Initiative for Impact Evaluation (3ie)](https://www.3ieimpact.org/) {.unlisted}
A global non-profit research organisation working with governments, foundations,
NGOs, and development and research organisations worldwide.
:::
::: {.card-e}
### [Innovation Growth Lab (IGL)](https://www.innovationgrowthlab.org/) {.unlisted}
A global partnership that supports governments to test and evaluate innovation,
entrepreneurship and growth policies.

**Go further**

- [IGL resources](https://www.innovationgrowthlab.org/resources): guides,
  toolkits and evidence for running policy experiments.
:::
::: {.card-e}
### [Inter-American Development Bank (IDB)](https://www.iadb.org/en/results-and-effectiveness/development-effectiveness/project-evaluation/impact-evaluations) {.unlisted}
The IDB's impact evaluation work, which measures the effects of the projects it
finances and shares the methods and lessons learned.
:::
::::

::: {.card-e}
### To add {.unlisted}
Contacts at managing authorities already running experimental evaluations, for teams that
want to speak to a peer rather than read a page.
:::
